central-cubby.purpose: Reconstruct the entire inner central cubby and its desk area so the empty architecture terminates at real wood-frame seams.

typewriter.purpose: Remove the typewriter, its paper and its contact shadow while preserving the surrounding cubby and desk.

correspondence-tray.purpose: Remove the correspondence tray and envelopes while preserving the right cubby and desk.

lamp.purpose: Remove the oil lamp assembly and its contact shadow while preserving the adjacent glass vase and window framing.

lamp-reflection.purpose: Remove the orphaned sharp lamp reflection from the polished desktop after the lamp body has been removed.

category-books.purpose: Remove the central upper-shelf category books and reconstruct the empty back panel up to the real shelf-frame seams.

category-books-junction-v2.purpose: Remove the remaining category-book spine bases and repair only the junction between the empty upper-bay back panel and its existing horizontal shelf beam.

correspondence-letter-lift-state.purpose: P3 interaction state: lift the top envelope from the approved correspondence tray for browsing while preserving the tray body, wax seal, shelf, right books, and all surrounding architecture.

category-books-diary-pull-state.purpose: P3 interaction state: pull one natural left-side group of adjacent upper-shelf books forward from the continuous book wall while preserving the shelf, neighboring books, beam, cubby, and all surrounding architecture.

category-books-memory-pull-state-v2.purpose: P3 interaction state repair: move one middle-left group of three adjacent upper-shelf books unmistakably to the shelf front edge, including the minimum neighboring overlap and rear-slot shadow needed to show real depth; preserve the shelf beam and all surrounding architecture.

category-books-third-group-pull-state.purpose: P3 group-level interaction state: move one central-right group of three adjacent upper-shelf books clearly to the shelf front edge, including only immediate overlap and rear-slot shadow; preserve the beam, neighboring row, glass cloche, and all surrounding architecture.

category-books-fourth-group-pull-state.purpose: P3 group-level interaction state: move one upper-shelf right-end group of three adjacent books clearly to the shelf front edge while preserving the glass cloche, horizontal beam, neighboring row, and all surrounding architecture.
